newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: EEI unit starts 460 mln peso road project.
newsitem.headline: EEI unit starts 460 mln peso road project.

text.p: EEI Corp said on Monday its subsidiary Philrock Inc had started a government road project which was worth up to 460 million pesos.
Philrock is laying down concrete over 44 kilometres of road and overlaying asphalt over 38 kilometres of road in the northern Philippines.
The project is being financed by the Department of Public Works and Highways and Overseas Economic Cooperation Fund of Japan.
The project is expected to be completed in two years time.
Philrock is engaged in roads and infrastucture development, construction and manufacture of concrete and aggregates.
